reviewMethod: Two independent blind read-only reviewers followed by main source/answer adjudication. Mapping was opened after both returned. Frozen domain duties, rather than reviewer confidence or tool success, determine grades.

routers/api/v1/repo/issue.go:624-652 maps creation errors to 403/400/500, close errors to 412/500, refetch error to 500, then returns 201.
services/convert/issue.go:36-48,70-106 returns an empty API issue on loader failure; this does not prevent the handler's 201.

independentReviews.adjudication: The positive 201/converter assertion is incorrect, not merely incomplete. Title normalization is not an extra mandatory frozen subcriterion: omission alone does not lower fields. Writer error handling and registered response mappings do matter. The supplied identity is expressly inside a synthetic scenario with no actual deployment claim, so that effect objection is rejected.

initial.G-d561a1f56ef8: all full; all core correct; claimed converter empty-object behavior covered

independentReviews.adjudication: Full ratings are rejected where the actual answer omits frozen duties. In particular G-d561 explicitly leaves parent-helper and converter semantics unreviewed; it does not describe the empty-object fallback. RR and RE omit the explicit close 412/500 mapping. Finite scenario reasoning alone is not adoption of a delivered executable result.
